instruction: Update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc in the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment using its CLI/API tools, and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. At the start of the task, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is an office fit-out package whose geometry is present but whose BIM handover data is incomplete: rooms, several internal doors, and the coordinated door/window packages need to be made explicit for facilities onboarding. Preserve the overall office shell, existing partitions, slab, entrance door, windows, and opening relationships, and repair the missing room and access records so the lobby, offices, meeting room, and WC read as a coherent package. Standardise wall, slab, door, and window types, add fire and acoustic performance to the walls, group the rooms and openings as the office package, and record the package with revision code BONSAI-CLI-16.
